name: mutual
description: Mutual: campus co-presence matching research prototype. See SPEC.md.

scripts.verify: npm run verify:py && npm run verify:js
scripts.verify:py: python -m pytest packages/protocol_py server sim -q -p no:warnings && python -m ruff check . && python -m ruff format --check .
scripts.verify:js: npm test -w packages/protocol-ts && npm run typecheck -w packages/protocol-ts && npm run lint -w app && npm run typecheck -w app && npm test -w app && npm run check:privacy -w app && npm run check:contrast -w app
